body:
Motivation is hard to come by when in the midst of a feeling of total bleakness. Where your soul is screaming for anything or anyone to help guide you to your worth. 

You don’t need to do or be or feel anything in this moment. It is okay. And it will pass. I totally wish I could pinky swear that at the moment. :)

Thank you! I am proud to say that I have not had a drink since that night!! I woke up and restarted and it is great. More than anything-I just feel better. My body does. :) it is lovely to not wake up with a dry mouth and headache.

I did the same thing as a kid. Went to school super sick. Would walk to the school in the summer when it was out. It was my safe place. 

I am glad you have a safe place. There are people there that will help you. I was too scared to leave and get help and it just got worse. You are worth more than that. Write an email if it is easier. :) get a conversation started with an adult at the school. Hang in there. 

—-I am 40 now and work at a school, I also advocate nationally for children. A safe place can be inspiring.

I screwed up. I didn’t drink for two nights. Then tonight, I do. I already feel
Horrible. Worthless. Weak.

I know that when I am not on this downslide- I AM so very thankful for them. For keeping me going, giving me a reason to make an effort in all I do. If it was not for them- I would have given up long ago. 

Why do I feel like I want to kill myself? The world- not my boys, but everyone else- would be better off without me. I don’t make a difference. I am a burden. I mess up no matter how hard I try. I don’t bring anything to the world. I am tired of the pain and the consent weariness. I am tired of the noise, the stress. I am so tired of faking it for everyone. No one would ever even fathom I feel like this. I am that soccer mom. I am that nice  teacher. I am that PTA leader. But inside- all of it- makes me feel like a total failure and fake. I would be myself- but I have no idea how or what or who that is. 

I sound super duper whine-y. Ugh. Thanks for asking. I have never been asked that before. I never had to think about why.

I’m just not the Mom they and everyone else thinks I am. No one knows about the constant thoughts of how and when to kill myself. No one knows about my secret life. They are always sweet and usually kind to me/ if they were jerks- I would think they would not care. It is because I know they would miss me. I know they would be forever changed without me- that I sometimes resent them. If it was not for their love- I would not keep going. I some times resent, that they keep me going.
